source: Fresh persistent authorized reference process; controller requests and image matching only. Native frames are actual response sums. All reset branches and failures retained.
limitations: Camera origin after coarse automatic prefixes is relative, not absolute; only subsequent camera deltas are registered.
Exact opaque template player matching can identify a shared subset pose during transformations; contact-sheet inspection is required.
Star and flower template detection recognizes supplied palettes only; palette cycling can produce false negatives.
Standing color probes use the last exact standing origin during neutral input; interpret only verified stationary intervals.

confirmedBlockContents.limitation: It remained a brick and produced no item in this small-player bump. Large-player destruction was not tested.

postShrinkInvulnerabilityNativeFrames.limitation: Images establish blinking and survival during contact; exact collision re-enable frame was not isolated.

powerupEmergenceNativeFrames.limitation: Block hit and first cap are bracketed by7/8-frame screenshots; no precise first emergence frame is claimed.

starNativeFrames.limitation: First normal sample could be a normal phase of the cycle; sustained normal samples bound expiry more loosely than a RAM/state interface would. Exact loss of collision protection was not separately tested.

starPaletteCadence.limitation: The observed slow and fast sequences do not support a claim of exact native-frame phase or changeover boundary.

fireballTerminalFallPixelsPerNativeFrame.limitation: Initial birth frame, subpixel phase, initial vertical speed and gravity remain unresolved.

observedPlayerPaletteRoles.limitation: Star white is distinct from the supplied Fire Mario palette. Preserve opaque black in the dark phase; only original sprite transparency is transparent. Color order/phase comes from actual captures below, not from changing the reference.

failedBranches.description: Attempted a second jump after walking off the second pipe; it did not trigger in the air and reproduced the genuine Goomba damage.
Kept Mario big, activated the1-1 flower and broke its left neighbor. An early horizontal pickup jump passed the flower before reaching it vertically, then fell into the second gap.
Fresh auto85 approach bumped the ordinary left brick, waited too long and died to the nearby Koopa.
Fresh auto85 approach successfully revealed the star from the right brick, then died before emergence completed.
Fresh auto95 backtracking let the camera pass the star block, leaving it outside the reachable left boundary.
